html:
José Antonio Páez was a Venezuelan general, leader of the llaneros, the cowboys of the plains, in the war of independence and the first president of independent Venezuela.

A former cattle hand with little schooling, he led the fierce horsemen of the llanos, who had first fought for Spain, onto the patriot side. At Las Queseras del Medio in 1819 a small band of his lancers routed a royalist army, and he led the cavalry at Carabobo.

He came to rule the region as a strongman and, in 1830, led Venezuela out of Gran Colombia against the wishes of Bolívar. He was president three times and the dominant figure of the country until the 1840s, and briefly dictator again in the 1860s. He died in exile in New York. He began the long line of caudillos who ruled Venezuela.
sum: José Antonio Páez was a Venezuelan general, leader of the llaneros, the cowboys of the plains, in the war of independence and the first president of independent Venezuela.
